title: A new species of the Dendropsophus decipiens Group (Anura: Hylidae) from Northeastern Brazil.

readScopes.readScope: Dendropsophus tapacurensis: Diagnosis, sex-specific type variation, explicit leaf egg placement, temporary pond calling, note-centred acoustic sample, mitochondrial relationship and unresolved historical identity/conservation limits; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Dendropsophus haddadi: Cryptic source identification and unresolved decipiens complex; historical acoustic values cited rather than measured uniformly in this study; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Dendropsophus oliveirai: Distinct morphology and historically attributed acoustic comparison despite sister relationship to tapacurensis; explicitly source-bounded syntopy; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
Dendropsophus decipiens: Source-labelled genetically structured lineages and paraphyly, not completed delimitation of accepted species; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Dendropsophus berthalutzae: Divergent source-labelled lineage and incompatible historical repertoire descriptions with unverified identity outside type region; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
